lines.en: I weave between the coral.
My body twists and I swim on.
My scales rasp against the reef.
I glide past an anemone.
I swim low along the sand.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面划出一条线。
lines.en: My tail leaves a line behind me.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚枝的缝里钻出去。
lines.en: I slip out through a gap in the coral.

lines.zh: 水流把我推得偏了一点。
lines.en: The current pushes me off a little.
I swim while poking my head about.

lines.zh: 泡从我嘴里冒出来，往上走。
lines.en: Bubbles leave my mouth and rise.

lines.zh: 我绕过一整片鹿角珊瑚。
lines.en: I go around a whole staghorn patch.

lines.zh: 浅水的光在我背上一格一格过。
lines.en: Light ripples band by band over my back.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁盘的坡往下滑。
lines.en: I slip down the slope of the reef.
I take a breath just under the surface.
I feel my way up the reef wall.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块礁石转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle that rock half way round.
I coil on the coral base.
My head is raised, swaying slowly.
Only my tail tip moves.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼从我面前逃开。
lines.en: A small fish darts away from me.
The water is clear; I can see far.
I listen to the sounds inside the reef.
My tongue tests the water.
Sea grass brushes over me.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一段珊瑚。
lines.en: I hold still, like a piece of coral.
The water here is just right.
I am a red thing that can swim.
Did you come down from the surface?

lines.zh: 你在珊瑚礁里太显眼了。
lines.en: You stand out too much among the coral.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩在沙上，扬起来一片。
lines.en: Your feet kick up a cloud of sand.
I circle once at your feet.
You are holding your breath.
This reef is mine.
I wind slowly around you.

lines.zh: 珊瑚缝里，我盯着你很久了。
lines.en: I've watched you from the coral cracks a good while.
A scale has been split.
I twist in the water.
It hurts, but I can still swim.
I recoil half a turn and coil.
Blood threads away between the coral.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我身上，很实。
lines.en: That landed solidly on me.
My scales are scraped open on the coral.
I press behind the reef.
I will come again.
I smell that blood.
Give me that fish in your hand.
I raise my head and come a little closer.
It is still moving; good.

lines.zh: 我的颌张开又慢慢合上。
lines.en: My jaws open and slowly close.
Don't shake it; I cannot aim.
Drop it; I will take it myself.
I'll swallow this fish in one bite.
You bump into me; I am slippery.
My scales scrape you.
The bump clouds the water.
I am far longer than you thought.
Don't step on me; I will coil.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，都弹开了。
lines.en: We collide and both bounce away.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩着我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your boot is on my tail.

lines.zh: 我慢慢松开，退到礁石后。
lines.en: I loosen and slip behind the coral.
After the bump, bubbles still rise.
I am not the only one on this reef.
Laying eggs is a matter of season.
I coil and do not answer.
You ask too far ahead.
I bury my head in the coral.
Such things are not spoken of in water.
I sway my tail and swim off.
You asked the wrong fish.
I am not at that time yet.
There is much to do on the reef.
I snap it up.

lines.zh: 我用牙把它从缝里拖出来。
lines.en: I drag it out of the crevice with my teeth.
It rolled under the coral.
Too hard; I cannot bite through.
I nudge it into the sand and bury it.
It feels like mine now.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看看有没有别人。
lines.en: I look up to check for others.
Take it; I will not eat it.
The water moves; I turn.
I level my head at you.
You are at the reef's edge; good.
I poke my head from the coral gap.
That smell is yours.
I swim toward you, not fast.

lines.zh: 你的脚踩进了我的地盘。
lines.en: Your feet have stepped into my ground.
The weeds lean as I pass.
Do not go deeper.

lines.zh: 我在你下面几尺的地方。
lines.en: I am a few feet below you.
You swim; I follow.
I pass through a brain coral.

lines.zh: 你在往浅水退，我看得见。
lines.en: I see you retreating to the shallows.
I coil on the reef and wait.
I extend my head to test.
You looked back again.
I know every gap here.

lines.zh: 我从你身后的珊瑚里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the coral behind you.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚蛋里孵出来，牙先长好。
lines.en: Hatched in coral, my fangs came first.
My body wraps your arm.

lines.zh: 这一下很快，水都翻起来。
lines.en: It is quick; the water churns.
I let go and recoil half a coil.
You slash at me and I slide away.
I raise my head to your waist.

lines.zh: 你挣得越猛，我缠得越紧。
lines.en: The harder you struggle, the tighter I coil.

lines.zh: 我的毒牙碰到了你的皮。
lines.en: My fangs touch your skin.
You retreat; I come around the other side.
That should leave you numb.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚礁的海生蛋里孵出。
lines.en: I hatch from a sea egg in the reef.
My first mouthful is seawater.
I am longer than I look.
This reef is only now seeing me.
I coil and adjust to the current.

lines.zh: 光从水面上一格一格落下来。
lines.en: Light falls band by band from the surface.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼从我旁边逃了。
lines.en: A small fish flees past me.
I lift my head and scan the sea.
The coral is all reddish.
The water heats and my scales draw tight.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔进浅水，砸得发懵。
lines.en: I fall into the shallows and lie stunned.

lines.zh: 奇怪，我在水里却喘不上气。
lines.en: Strange that I cannot breathe in water.

lines.zh: 爆响在水里闷闷地传开。
lines.en: The blast rolls dully through the water.

lines.zh: 一根鱼叉扎进我的侧腹。
lines.en: A harpoon lodges in my flank.

lines.zh: 术力像海草一样缠住我。
lines.en: The spell coils around me like weed.

lines.zh: 礁盘上没有鱼，我越来越弱。
lines.en: No fish on the reef; I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条身子都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body goes numb.
The water is gone and I twist at nothing.
